sights.n: Kiyomizu-dera, Osaka (清水寺, Tamade no Taki)
sights.address: Tennōji-ku, Osaka (top of Kiyomizu-zaka, one of the Tennōji Seven Slopes)
sights.w: Osaka's own Kiyomizu-dera, with a mini 'Kiyomizu stage' looking toward Tsūtenkaku and the Tamade-no-taki waterfall — the only natural waterfall inside Osaka city; listed by Time Out Osaka and Osaka Metro's Osaka Mania (Kiyomizu-zaka).
